m2-session-helper.title: session_cumulative_track_laps in session_race.py
m2-session-helper.imperative: Add `session_cumulative_track_laps(year, gp, session_type, constructor, db_path, *, session_id=None) -> Optional[int]` to session_race.py: resolve the constructor's driver_ids for that weekend via session_classifications.team (read-only sqlite, _ro_uri pattern), find the fastest clean (valid_lap=1) lap among those drivers' lap_times rows in the session, take its lap_number as the anchor, and return compute_cumulative_track_laps(session_id, anchor_lap_number, db_path) UNCHANGED (do not modify that function). Return None on any absence (session/constructor/clean-lap not found), never raise. Docstring must state the approximation explicitly: a single scalar per (session, constructor) anchored at one representative lap, while the estimator itself pools observations across many laps at varying track states.
